---
abstract: |
  A chapter whose only index mark is in its own YAML front matter:
  [Hasp]{.index}. The ordinary render indexes it, because a filter table
  carrying a `Span` function visits a document's metadata as well as its
  blocks, and the recovery route has to reach it the same way.
---

# A chapter marking only in its front matter

The body of this chapter marks nothing at all, so what reaches the index from
it reaches it from the front matter above or not at all.
